column1: # rules/rule_table.tsv — TOTAL verdict function: (observation tuple, assumptions) -> verdict
# Consumed by bsec/replay.sh judge. First matching rule wins; if NO rule matches, or any
# referenced field is not one of the enumerated values, the verdict is UNKNOWN (fail-closed).
# Verdict semantics (corrected 2026-10-11; encoded here and in ../JUDGMENT.md / ../verdicts.md):
#   GO      security impact reproduced under the stated attacker model and real consumer path
#   NO-GO   the stated scope of paths and impact hypotheses was TESTED and the observed
#           result does not support a security-impact claim  (NOT "no impact exists")
#   N/A     evidence confirms the path is unreachable in this exact consumer AND version
#   UNKNOWN reachability, attacker control, or impact is insufficiently established
# Scoping rules (binding, not advisory):
#   * NO-GO is a SCOPED verdict. It never transfers to other consumers, attacker models, or
#     revisions, and it is NOT a proof the ecosystem is safe.
#   * Observing one valid contrast input + fail-closed behavior does NOT exclude all possible
#     security impact — anything beyond the tested scope stays UNKNOWN.
# Fields (observation tuple; values in <> are literals, * = any, incl. missing/undefined):
#   defect_live        present|absent|unparseable   — LIVE run: B-1 defect pair reproduced? (replay.sh judge derives)
#   consumer_path      executes|not_used|unknown
#   valid_contrast     equivalent|differs|unknown   — defect input ≡ some valid config? (capability delta)
#   boundary           neutralizes|does_not|unknown — protection boundary erases the gain?
#   artifact           present|absent               — call-site investigation artifact on record?
